title: Fix coarse-mtime stale cache reads in cached_file_bytes and commit_log term claims
goal: Include Unix (dev, ino) in cached_file_bytes stamps and use uncached read_atomic_bytes with a 15s FileLock wait in commit_log read-modify-write paths so cross-process term claims serialize without stale cache reads under parallel load.

reuse.source: Existing first-party susi-config and susi-core primitives; zero new dependencies.
reuse.reason: Include Unix (dev, ino) in cached_file_bytes stamp and use uncached read_atomic_bytes + 15s FileLock wait in commit_log read-modify-write paths.

limitations: Windows x86_64 reference build and qualification remain owed on a Windows x86_64 host.
